title: Haul-Away Charge Calculation for Northgate Delivery & Installation Installation Appointments
content:
The haul-away charge on a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment is the old appliances removed beyond the service level's included haul-away items, at the service level's per-item haul-away fee. The charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up.

## The quantities

1. **Old appliances removed** — one for each appliance the appointment installs, being the kit units the appointment's installation parts kit entries carry, in all.
2. **Included haul-away items** — the service level's old items removed at no charge, as the level's haul-away figures state them.
3. **Removed beyond the included items** — the old appliances removed less the included haul-away items, never below zero.
4. **Per-item haul-away fee** — the service level's fee per old item removed beyond those included.
5. **Charge** — the removed appliances beyond the included items multiplied by the per-item haul-away fee, rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up.

## Worked figures (hypothetical level: 1 included item, $30.00 an item)

| Kit units on the installation parts kit entries | Old appliances removed | Beyond the included item | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 0 | Nothing beyond the included item |
| 2 | 2 | 1 | $30.00 |
| 3 | 3 | 2 | $60.00 |
